title: Madrigal's MASH Platform Strategy: Rezdiffra as the Cornerstone, siRNA as the Next Growth Engine
summary: Rezdiffra has opened the MASH market and built its commercialization infrastructure. Madrigal is now adding six Ribo siRNA programs and Arrowhead's ARO-PNPLA3 to create a cornerstone-plus-precision-combination treatment matrix.
cover_image_alt: A liver, Rezdiffra and precision gene-silencing signals visualize Madrigal's MASH cornerstone-drug and siRNA platform strategy
homepage_cover_image_alt: Madrigal expands from Rezdiffra as a MASH cornerstone into a precision siRNA combination matrix
